full-screen capture, look back at any frame of the last ~20 minutes by timestamp, and "},{"id":"p3s3","text":"mouse/keyboard injection."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Two halves talking over stdio, one JSON request per line:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| Half | Where | What it does |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Plugin (`lib/index.js`) | WSL, inside the DSH host process | registers the model-visible tools, ow"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ns the helper process, hands frames to the model |
| Helper (`helper/CuHelper.exe`) | Windows | desk"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"top capture (DXGI, GDI fallback), H.264 segment ring buffer, keyboard/mouse injection, window enumer"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ture (DXGI, GDI fallback), H.264 segment ring buffer, keyboard/mouse injection, window enumeration |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The plugin starts the helper once and keeps it resident (a fresh process per frame would pay tens of"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" milliseconds
of GDI/DXGI initialization every time). Frame files land in the Windows temp directory"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" and are read back through
`/mnt/<drive>/...`."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- DSH running in **WSL**; the Windows helper is launched through WSL interop. A pure-Windows DSH ins"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"tall does not
work as written, because Windows paths are mapped as `/mnt/<drive>/...`.
- Windows wit"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"h **.NET Framework 4** (present on every supported Windows). No SDK, no ffmpeg, no third-party binar"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"y.
- Screen resolution decides the tile geometry: tiles are sized to fit the harness image budget, s"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"o a 2560×1440
desktop yields 2×3 tiles of 1280×480 (614,400 px each, delivered unscaled)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Install the operating discipline as a skill (the package ships an English `SKILL.md`; nothing instal"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"rating discipline as a skill (the package ships an English `SKILL.md`; nothing installs it for you):"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Capture and inspection: `screen_grid` (one capture → thumbnail + 1:1 tiles, optionally `atSeconds` f"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"or a frame from
the buffer), `screen_frames` (pull a time range out of the recording buffer; every i"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"mage carries its capture time),
`screen_watch` (start/stop/stats of the continuous capture), `screen"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"_windows` (window under a point, foreground
window, or full enumeration), `cursor_state`."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Actions: `mouse_move_to`, `mouse_move_by`, `click`, `mouse_button`, `drag`, `scroll`, `type_text`, `"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"press_key`,
`key_state`, `hotkey`, `wait`."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Optional tools stay unregistered unless enabled in configuration: `wait_for_change` / `act_when` (`t"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"riggerTools`),
`screen_observe` / `region_observe` (`singleImageTools`), `screen_diff` (`diffTool`)."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Every knob lives in `cordis.patch.yml`, and **the shipped defaults are not a neutral baseline**: the"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"y are the
configuration one GUI-evaluation setup runs with. Out of the box you get a **16-tool** sur"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"face; switching the four
optional groups on widens it to **21 tools** and re-enables ordinary image "},{"id":"p20s4","text":"itching the four
optional groups on widens it to **21 tools** and re-enables ordinary image reading."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Read those four defaults as answers to four questions, not as arbitrary flags:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| Switch | Default | With the default | Turning it on adds |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| `triggerTools` | `false` | nothing watches the screen waiting for a condition | `wait_for_change`,"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" `act_when` — poll a region until it changes, then act |
| `singleImageTools` | `false` | screen rea"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ding only ever arrives as the same-frame thumbnail + tiles form | `screen_observe`, `region_observe`"},{"id":"p23s4","text":" — hand back a single image |
| `denyReadImage` | **`true`** | a tool guard rejects **every** `read_"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"image` call — with or without `region`, for every session, not only screen captures | normal image r"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"eading works again |
| `diffTool` | `false` | no frame differencing | `screen_diff` — report which g"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"|
| `diffTool` | `false` | no frame differencing | `screen_diff` — report which grid cells changed |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Why those defaults: on a 2560×1440 desktop a single full-screen image is either downscaled past legi"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"bility (a 46 px
control becomes 19 px) or covers one corner, so the plugin standardizes on one full-"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"view form — `screen_grid`, one
capture turned into a same-frame thumbnail plus 1:1 tiles. Letting `r"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"ead_image` back in would restore the
single-image path for *any* image, not only screen captures. Th"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"e `triggerTools` entry is an evaluation constraint
(watching for a visual condition and then acting "},{"id":"p24s6","text":"counts as cheating in that setting), not a technical limit. The
comments in the file record each dec"},{"id":"p24s7","text":" as cheating in that setting), not a technical limit. The
comments in the file record each decision."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The remaining keys are ordinary capture settings:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| Key | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| `backend` | `dxgi` | capture backend: `dxgi` (GPU copy, ~0.42 ms/frame) or `gdi` (~28.9 ms/frame) "},{"id":"p27s2","text":"` | `dxgi` | capture backend: `dxgi` (GPU copy, ~0.42 ms/frame) or `gdi` (~28.9 ms/frame) |

and Cordis `ctx.effect` for ownership."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Verified by a live run on a clean install: harness `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-rc.1` (the newest publish"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"ed release at the
time of writing) in a fresh `DSH_HOME`, this repository cloned from GitHub and lin"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"ked into the profile — the plugin
loads and all 16 tools register. The same symbols are also present"},{"id":"p30s4","text":" in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools@0.1.5-rc.3`."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Limits"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- **The desktop is a single shared resource.** Keyboard and mouse are global: two DSH instances on t"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"he same machine
must not act at the same time, or their actions interleave.
- Capture runs at the ra"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"te fixed by `frameIntervalMs` (40 fps in the shipped patch) and costs roughly a quarter of
one core "},{"id":"p32s4","text":"while active. The rate is a deployment choice, not a tool argument: `screen_watch` has no `fps` para"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"meter.
- **The per-frame interval bound is met at the shipped rate, with a rare exception.** The tar"},{"id":"p32s6","text":"get is that no frame
